purposes.seed: Repeatable grain, stone mottling and small decorative wear placements.
purposes.edge_bevel_m: Small worn arrises catch light without enlarging the collision envelope.
purposes.plank_seam_m: Visible joinery seams distinguish a built furnishing from a solid cube.
purposes.grain_strength: Restrained wood fibre contrast at player distance.
purposes.stone_mottle_strength: Stone face variation keeps masonry readable without a checkerboard effect.
purposes.iron_mottle_strength: Very subtle forged surface variation avoids a striped or polished metal appearance.
purposes.wood_roughness: Dry weathered timber rather than varnished furniture.
purposes.iron_roughness: Dull forged metal with broad, quiet highlights.
purposes.iron_metallic: Restrained metal reflections under both Blender and Godot daylight.
purposes.ember_emission: Static review ember visibility; no fuel, heat or light gameplay change.
purposes.candidate_collision_height_m: PROPOSAL ONLY: solid station height in the separate fit exports; clears the air above worktops and forge silhouettes while retaining the original horizontal footprint.

proportion_notes.chest: Dimensions and cell-bottom pivot from construction/PieceMesh. Lid begins at 72 percent of height, retaining the current split. The lid hinge is at the rear; closed geometry fits the existing box without the old 6 percent overhang.
proportion_notes.workbench: StationLook's 0.94 by 0.92 m top, 0.95 m top height and four 0.8 m legs. A small vice and hand plane are non-interactive silhouette details.
proportion_notes.mason_yard: Same station footprint and top height; dressed stone working surface, rough workpiece and small chisel distinguish it from timber joinery.
proportion_notes.forge_basic: StationLook's 0.9 m base, 0.95 m lintel and 1.575 m maximum height. Open hearth and inset coals face local positive Z.
proportion_notes.forge_improved: Same base and footprint; taller hood reaches the existing 1.96 m height, with dark iron bands for upgrade recognition.
proportion_notes.campfire: Construction's fuel pile size and PieceMesh's half-height floor anchor and low collider. Three charred timber logs and coals; no decorative stone ring implying a new material cost.
proportion_notes.candidate_collisions: PROPOSAL: station collision height 0.95 m at bench/mason worktops, 1.575 m at the basic forge and 1.96 m at the improved forge. Preserve the existing 0.96 m horizontal box, solid underside and ground origin. Small worktop tools remain decorative. Separate fit GLBs only; normal gameplay is unchanged.
proportion_notes.review: Catalogue positions, neutral plinths, workshop floor and studio lights are presentation aids only.
